title: nutrient-rich malaysian tagliatelle pasta
description: a fresh, shaggy post-workout malaysian dish made with dashi-extract and featuring tagliatelle a favorite at local buddhist temples
instructions: cook the tagliatelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, then drain and set aside
in a large skillet heat the ghee over medium heat
add the toasted coconut flakes and cook stirring occasionally for 2-3 minutes until lightly browned
add the toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, honey, and ground ginger to the skillet and stir to combine
add the cooked tagliatelle pasta to the skillet and toss with the coconut and spice mixture
stir in the dashi extract and chopped scallions
season with salt and pepper to taste
serve the pasta hot garnished with additional toasted coconut flakes if desired
